paragraphs: it has come to our attention that several local companies/organizations are receiving emails with the subject request for quotations (rfq – pdf 1 mb) for solar generators. the emails are sent from embassy@tendersdept.com and claim to be from the u.s. embassy tashkent. this is a fraudulent email and the u.s. embassy did not send it. spam email can contain viruses or links to malicious websites.  the embassy recommends: do not click on any links, images, attachments contained in the email do not respond to this email. do not forward this email. in the future if you receive a request for quotations or solicitation from the u.s. embassy, you can check if it’s legitimate by viewing the u.s. embassy procurement office’s official website or contacting the procurement office on +998(78)-120-5450 .
it has come to our attention that several local companies/organizations are receiving emails with the subject request for quotations (rfq – pdf 1 mb) for solar generators.
